snippet.title: Spacefleet: HEAT DEATH - Early Access Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Download Spacefleet: HEAT DEATH now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3854580/Spacefleet_Heat_Death/?beta=0
Check out JEEPNEY SIMULATOR 2 here!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2819970/Jeepney_Simulator_2

EARTH ORBIT IS ABOUT TO BURN. HEAT DEATH is a sci-fi space RPG inspired by the likes of The Expanse and Through Struggle, The Stars. Trade, fight, and lead your way to domination in this one-of-a-kind RPG!
